title: Recursive Defect Localization from Merkle Trees to Executable Coherence
summary: This cross-domain synthesis compares Merkle Trees as Recursive Defect Localization to test whether a shared structural vocabulary survives translation without erasing their distinct native proof, model, or interpretation obligations. title: Resolution Operators and Observation-Conditioned Access
summary: This paper candidate develops “Resolution Operators and Observation-Conditioned Access” from material already present in the Lab corpus. Its current claim ceiling is there is a durable cross-domain idea, but it must be calibrated against existing measurement theory, POVMs/instruments, sampling/resolution theory, coarse-graining, and operator semantics before claiming a new measurement formalism. The current artifact state is legacy manuscript candidate re-routed through current publication controls. The next evidence obligation is probe-object-interface co-evolution as measurement state; resolution hierarchy as explicit access contract. Prior to promotion, it requires review against compare against native measurement/instrument/resolution formalisms and demonstrate a nontrivial common access contract.
